profile.headline: C# .Net Developer | Entity Framework
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Developer with extensive experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web and mobile applications across healthcare, fintech, insurance, and e-learning domains.

Skilled in C# and .NET technologies, I specialize in building APIs, managing full-stack web platforms, and developing cross-platform mobile applications using .NET MAUI. I have strong experience with cloud services, particularly Microsoft Azure (Functions, Service Bus, App Insights, Kubernetes), and hands-on exposure to AWS services such as Amazon Cognito.

I focus on writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code by applying modern software architecture and design patterns including Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Factory, Builder, and Pipeline patterns. I also leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance development efficiency and deliver intelligent features.
